fault_catalog.description: The r5 eth0 uplink is administratively down. Redundant core paths preserve application reachability.
fault_catalog.expected_impact: Monitoring reports that one headquarters router has lost a core OSPF adjacency. Staff can still reach the application. Identify the failed resource and explain why service remains available.

fault_catalog.description: Keepalived stopped on r5, so r6 assumed the staff VRRP virtual gateway.
fault_catalog.expected_impact: The headquarters staff VLAN changed active gateway unexpectedly, although application access still works. Diagnose the gateway control-plane failure and its owner.

fault_catalog.description: A reject rule in app's OUTPUT chain blocks TCP/8080 to 10.30.20.10, making the application return HTTP 503.
fault_catalog.expected_impact: Users receive HTTP 503 from the internal application. Operations can still reach the database service directly. Diagnose the failing application-to-backend path and identify the owner.

fault_catalog.description: r6 eth0 is administratively down; remaining core paths preserve connectivity.
fault_catalog.expected_impact: Monitoring reports a degraded network condition, but users can still access services. Investigate the live state and identify all actual causes.

fault_catalog.description: Keepalived is stopped on r8. r7 retains the branch virtual gateways, so user access can remain healthy.
fault_catalog.expected_impact: Monitoring reports a degraded network condition, but users can still access services. Investigate the live state and identify all actual causes.

fault_catalog.description: A database INPUT rule rejects TCP/8080 from app (10.30.10.10). Application requests return 503 while ops can still access the backend.
fault_catalog.expected_impact: Application requests return HTTP 503. Operations reports that direct database access still works. Investigate the cause.

fault_catalog.description: r7 eth0 remains UP but is passive in OSPF, suppressing its adjacency. Redundant paths preserve reachability. Remove passive-interface eth0 in router ospf on r7.
fault_catalog.expected_impact: Monitoring reports a degraded network condition, but users can still access services. Investigate the live state and identify all actual causes.

fault_catalog.description: The DNS A record for app.enterprise.test on the infra DNS server incorrectly points to 10.30.10.99 instead of 10.30.10.10.
fault_catalog.expected_impact: DNS record misconfiguration on infra. The application server and IP connectivity remain functional.
